text.name: mc_help_p1_text
text.text: Instead of selling your milk at the fluctuating daily price, you sign a fixed contract with a dairy. While it runs, the dairy collects the agreed milk from your barn automatically every day and pays the contract price. Each dairy has its own character: price, quantity rule, payout rhythm, term and sometimes animal-welfare requirements. You reach the contract menu via its own tab in the game menu.

text.name: mc_help_p2_text
text.text: The mod supports cow milk, goat milk and buffalo milk. Use the arrows at the top of the menu to switch between the types; the list, status and buttons then refer to the selected type. You can run one contract of each type at the same time - so a cow, a goat and a buffalo contract in parallel. Each type has its own line-up of dairies.

text.name: mc_help_p3_text
text.text: While a contract is active, milk is collected from the barn automatically every day: from the tank for cows, from the produced pallets for goats. You never have to haul it to the dairy yourself. Whatever the dairy does not take - for example above a maximum quota - stays in storage and can still be sold yourself. With no active contract, you sell as usual.

text.name: mc_help_p4_text
text.text: The price is either fixed per liter or market-linked (daily price times a factor, so it moves with the market). Each offer also has a random term between 3 and 24 months. The longer the term, the higher the price bonus - committing longer pays off. Term and bonus price are locked in at signing and then apply for the whole contract.

text.name: mc_help_p5_text
text.text: Money accrues and is paid out on the agreed rhythm: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly. The rhythm counts from the contract start, not from the calendar year. At contract end the remaining balance is always paid out. A short message informs you of each payout.

text.name: mc_help_p6_text
text.text: Not all dairies are available at once. The offer consists of a fixed base dairy plus a random selection (four to five in total) - separately for cow and goat. Once a year the offer is reshuffled. A contract you currently have stays visible in the menu even if its dairy is not in the current offer.

text.name: mc_help_p7_text
text.text: The quantity rule sets how much is taken: 'free' takes everything, 'minimum' requires a share of your estimated production, 'maximum' caps the amount per month. Some premium dairies additionally require terms such as a minimum herd health. You can see all conditions in the detail view before you sign.

text.name: mc_help_p8_text
text.text: If you commit to a minimum quota and fail to deliver it by contract end, a penalty applies to the shortfall (shortfall times price times factor). This penalty is shown as its own item in the detail view already at signing, so you know in advance what you are getting into. Contracts without a minimum quota have no such penalty.

text.name: mc_help_p9_text
text.text: In the last month before expiry you are warned and can renew the contract - on the old terms plus a small loyalty bonus on the price. If you did not fully meet a minimum quota, renewing carries the shortfall over into the next year as a redelivery (instead of a cash penalty): the new target is the normal target plus the outstanding amount. If instead you let the contract lapse, the normal penalty applies.

text.name: mc_help_p10_text
text.text: You can cancel an active contract early at any time. A termination fee applies, based on the contract's remaining open value (remaining value times 1.2). Before cancelling, the game asks you in a dialog whether you really want to proceed at the stated fee. This lets you get out of a contract when needed, but at an extra cost.
